description_en: Confirms an invitation initiated by the main account for a linked account
description_zh: 子账号确认主账号发起的邀约
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi confirm-relation --confirm-code child_agree --request-id request_id --permission-codes SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfirmRelation

parameters.help_en: The relationship type. Valid values: enterprise_group
parameters.name: relation_type

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the main account
parameters.name: parent_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The confirmation action. Valid values:
child_agree: The linked account agrees.
child_disagree: The linked account rejects.
主账号取消确认: The main account cancels the confirmation
parameters.help_zh:
确认动作：

子账号同意：child_agree
子账号拒绝：child_disagree
主账号取消确认：主账号取消确认
parameters.name: confirm_code

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the linked account
parameters.name: child_user_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the request
parameters.name: request_id

parameters.help_en:
The permissions granted to the linked account. Valid values:
SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY: Allows synchronizing the credit-based payment identity to the linked account.
SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET: Allows synchronizing discounts to the linked account.
FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH: Prohibits the linked account from withdrawing cash from the balance.
FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE: Prohibits the linked account from managing invoices.
CHECK_FINANCE_INFO: Allows requesting to view the account linking information.
MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE: Allows managing invoices of the target account.
CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION: Allows viewing the consumption information of the linked account
parameters.help_zh:
授予子账号的权限数据，权限点如下：
允许同步信控身份给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY
允许同步优惠给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET
禁止关联账户余额提现：FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH
禁止关联账户管理发票：FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE
请求查看财务关联信息：CHECK_FINANCE_INFO
允许管理目标发票：MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE
允许查看关联账户消费信息：CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION
parameters.name: permission_codes

parameters.help_en: The relationship ID. You can obtain the value from the relationId field in the response of the QueryRelationList operation
parameters.help_zh: 关系ID。取值从QueryRelationList接口返回的结果字段relationId获取
parameters.name: relation_id
